name: ViiNeuS Hybrid Volume Rendering
definition: A volume rendering strategy that computes final pixel color by alpha-compositing samples, where each sample's alpha value is dynamically assigned to be either a volumetric density-based alpha ($\alpha^{iv}$) or a signed distance field-based alpha ($\alpha^{if}$), transitioning from pure volumetric to pure SDF representation during training.
summary: ViiNeuS Hybrid Volume Rendering is a progressive training strategy that stabilizes implicit neural surface reconstruction by dynamically blending volumetric and SDF-based alpha compositing during optimization.
